8: ## Abstract
9: 
10: Abstract Objective Liver biopsy is still needed for fibrosis staging in many patients with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease. The aims of this study were to evaluate the individual diagnostic performance of liver stiffness measurement by vibration controlled transient elastography (LSM-VCTE), Fibrosis-4 Index (FIB-4) and NAFLD (non-alcoholic fatty liver disease) Fibrosis Score (NFS) and to derive diagnostic strategies that could reduce the need for liver biopsies. Design Individual patient data meta-analysis of studies evaluating LSM-VCTE against liver histology was conducted. FIB-4 and NFS were computed where possible. Sensitivity, specificity and area under the receiver operating curve (AUROC) were calculated. Biomarkers were assessed individually and in sequential combinations. Results Data were included from 37 primary studies (n=5735; 45% women; median age: 54 years; median body mass index: 30 kg/m 2 ; 33% had type 2 diabetes; 30% had advanced fibrosis). AUROCs of individual LSM-VCTE, FIB-4 and NFS for advanced fibrosis were 0.85, 0.76 and 0.73. Sequential combination of FIB-4 cut-offs (<1.3; ≥2.67) followed by LSM-VCTE cut-offs (<8.0; ≥10.0 kPa) to rule-in or rule-out advanced fibrosis had sensitivity and specificity (95% CI) of 66% (63–68) and 86% (84–87) with 33% needing a biopsy to establish a final diagnosis. FIB-4 cut-offs (<1.3; ≥3.48) followed by LSM cut-offs (<8.0; ≥20.0 kPa) to rule out advanced fibrosis or rule in cirrhosis had a sensitivity of 38% (37–39) and specificity of 90% (89–91) with 19% needing biopsy. Conclusion Sequential combinations of markers with a lower cut-off to rule-out advanced fibrosis and a higher cut-off to rule-in cirrhosis can reduce the need for liver biopsies. Keywords: hepatic fibrosis, fatty liver, clinical decision making, biostatistics
11: 
12: Significance of this study What is already known on this subject? Patients with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) and advanced fibrosis (F3–4) are at risk of disease progression and adverse clinical outcomes. Non-invasive tests with predefined cut-offs are used as screening biomarkers to identify those at low risk of advanced fibrosis who can be safely managed in primary care. Liver biopsy is still needed in secondary care to further identify those with cirrhosis who would benefit from surveillance for hepatocellular cancer and screening for oesophageal varices.
13: 
14: Significance of this study What are the new findings? Existing non-invasive tests cut-offs are validated for their use as screening biomarkers to rule out advanced fibrosis in a study group of 5735 patients. The sequential combination of Fibrosis-4 Index (FIB-4) (<1.3; ≥2.67) and liver stiffness measurement by vibration controlled transient elastography (LSM-VCTE) (<8.0 kPa; ≥10.0 kPa) which is increasingly used in routine practice has a false negative rate of 9% for advanced fibrosis. The diagnostic performance of LSM-VCTE for advanced fibrosis is influenced by biopsy quality, body mass index and presence of type 2 diabetes. An algorithm combining FIB-4 and LSM-VCTE sequentially with lower cut-offs to rule out advanced fibrosis (FIB-4 <1.3; LSM-VCTE <8.0 kPa) and with upper cut-offs to rule-in and positively diagnose cirrhosis without the need for liver biopsy with specificity of 95% (FIB-4 ≥3.48; LSM-VCTE ≥20.0 kPa) or 98% (FIB-4 ≥4.63; LSM-VCTE ≥28.0 kPa) can reduce the need for liver biopsies from 33% to 19% or 24%, respectively. How might it impact on clinical practice in the foreseeable future? The non-invasive test cut-offs for the diagnosis of cirrhosis can be incorporated into clinical practice as they have been validated in a large group of patients. Application of these cut-offs can lead to a decrease in the need for liver biopsies in secondary care.
15: 
16: ## Introduction
17: 
18: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is the hepatic manifestation of the metabolic syndrome with high prevalence worldwide. 1 Most patients remain asymptomatic for long periods of time (years/decades) with slowly progressive disease, but a minority 2 progress to cirrhosis, liver failure and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).
19: 
20: NAFLD comprises several histological features ranging from simple steatosis to steatosis with lobular inflammation and ballooned hepatocytes (steatohepatitis), both of which can be accompanied by varying degrees of fibrosis. The currently accepted reference standard for diagnosing NAFLD is liver biopsy as its diagnostic features are based on histology. 3 Liver biopsy, however, is invasive and carries a risk of complications, 4 is limited by sampling variability 5 and high observer dependent variability in pathological reporting. 6 7
21: 
22: NAFLD is often diagnosed after incidental findings of elevated liver transaminases on blood tests, or liver steatosis or cirrhosis on imaging. One challenge clinicians face is to identify which of these patients are at high risk of progression or clinical outcomes, as they would benefit from specialist follow-up. There is now substantial evidence showing that those with at least advanced fibrosis (F3–4) are at higher risk of liver-related events in later life. 8–10
23: 
24: A large body of evidence also exists on how non-invasive tests (NITs) could be used to risk-stratify patients for the presence of advanced fibrosis. These approaches usually involve sequential application of two NITs, with the first tier of a simple, inexpensive, serum-based test performed in the community (eg, Fibrosis-4 Index (FIB-4) or NAFLD Fibrosis Score (NFS)), followed by a second tier of liver stiffness measurement (LSM) (eg, vibration controlled transient elastography: VCTE), or a proprietary serum-based test (eg, enhanced liver fibrosis test; ELF). A lower and an upper threshold are usually used in each tier of testing to rule out (those with a NIT result less than the lower threshold) or rule in (those with a NIT result more than the upper threshold) patients at high risk of advanced fibrosis. Patients with indeterminate results in both tiers of testing would need a liver biopsy for risk stratification. The main value of these approaches lies in their high negative predictive value to rule out patients with low risk of advanced fibrosis who can be safely managed in primary care.
25: 
26: Despite the increasing evidence to support these approaches, some aspects of their application require further clarifications. First, there is no consensus on which NIT thresholds to use for this purpose. For example, FIB-4 upper cut-offs of 3.25 11 and 2.67 12 have been described, while other investigators omit the FIB-4 upper cut-off altogether. 13 There is also some uncertainty about the performance of NITs in specific patient subgroups, such as those with diabetes or obesity. Furthermore, for patients who are ruled in as being at high risk of advanced fibrosis (F3–4), liver biopsy is often needed to identify those with cirrhosis who would need surveillance for HCC. 14 Developing approaches that can minimise the need for liver biopsy in secondary care is therefore an area of unmet need.
27: 
28: To address these problems, we conducted an individual patient data meta-analysis (IPDMA) with three main aims: (1) to evaluate the performance of LSM-VCTE and compare it to the performance of FIB-4 and NFS as screening tests to rule out advanced fibrosis; (2) to evaluate NIT combination strategies to minimise the number of cases that would need a liver biopsy in secondary care; (3) to explore factors that influence diagnostic accuracy.
29: 
30: ## Methods
31: 
32: This IPDMA was reported in accordance with the recommendations of the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses-IPD Statement 15 and was registered as PROSPERO CRD42019157661.
33: 
34: ### Criteria for considering studies for the IPD meta-analysis
35: 
36: #### Patients
37: 
38: Studies reporting data on adults (≥18 years) with NAFLD and paired liver histology and LSM-VCTE were eligible. When studies reported study groups of participants with unselected aetiologies, only IPD of those with NAFLD were sought.
39: 
40: #### Index tests
41: 
42: The index test of main interest was LSM-VCTE performed with FibroScan (Echosens, France). Results for serum-based biomarkers NSF, 16 FIB-4, 17 aspartate aminotransferase (AST) to alanine aminotransferase (ALT) ratio 18 and AST-to-platelet ratio index (APRI) 19 ) were also computed where data were available. Online supplemental table 1 summarises the definition of NITs considered in this IPDMA.
43: 
44: **Supplementary data.** Supplementary data gutjnl-2021-324243supp001.pdf
45: 
46: Universally accepted cut-offs for diagnosing different groups of fibrosis stages do not exist (several suggested cut-offs are presented in online supplemental table 2 ). For LSM-VCTE, <7.9 kPa and ≥9.6 kPa are the most used for respectively ruling out and in, advanced fibrosis. 20
47: 
48: #### Reference standard
49: 
50: Only studies reporting histological classification of liver fibrosis based on the non-alcoholic steatohepatitis Clinical Research Network (NASH CRN) staging system were considered. 21
51: 
52: #### Target conditions
53: 
54: Advanced fibrosis (F3–4) and cirrhosis (F4) were the target conditions of interest. To fulfil the aims of the study, cut-offs were selected to rule out or rule in advanced fibrosis, and to rule out advanced fibrosis or rule in cirrhosis.
55: 
56: #### Study design
57: 
58: All study designs were considered if they were reporting on patients with NAFLD undergoing both liver biopsy and LSM-VCTE within 6 months. No language restrictions were applied.
59: 
60: ### Establishing collaborations
61: 
62: Authors of eligible studies were contacted by email and reminders were sent if a response was not received within 2 weeks. Only data from studies that received ethical approval were used. Additional ethical approval was not sought for the meta-analysis as only anonymised data were provided.
63: 
64: ### Data verification
65: 
66: Range checks of measurement values provided for individual patients were carried out and authors were asked to provide clarifications where necessary. Missing data were queried until received or confirmed as unavailable. Missing data were handled in the analysis by pairwise deletion.
67: 
68: LSM-VCTE with median stiffness ≥7.1 kPa and IQR-to-median LSM ratio >30% were considered unreliable. 22 These were included in the main analysis and were later compared in a subgroup analysis to reliable measurements, to assess whether they can be reliably used to diagnose advanced fibrosis.
69: 
70: Authors were provided with a template table of required data ( online supplemental table 3 ) and were asked to deduplicate data were possible. We also checked for duplicate entries and where identified these were removed.
71: 
72: ### Data analysis
73: 
74: #### Quality and bias assessment
75: 
76: The quality of studies was assessed using the Quality Assessment of Diagnostic Accuracy Studies tool (QUADAS-2). 23
77: 
78: #### IPD meta-analysis
79: 
80: The original data sets were merged, a study identification variable was added, and descriptive statistical analysis of the data sets was conducted. Dichotomous variables are displayed as percentages. Continuous variables are reported as means with SD, or medians with IQRs according to the distribution of the data.
81: 
82: Analyses were done per protocol, as we did not have information on failed LSM-VCTE. To express the diagnostic performance of NITs, non-parametric, empirical receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves were constructed for the target conditions of interest. Diagnostic performance was expressed as the area under the ROC curve (AUROC) with 95% CI, based on De Long’s method. AUROCs were compared using De Long’s test statistic.
83: 
84: Thresholds to maximise the Youden index (ie, sensitivity+specificity−1), for 90% sensitivity, and for 90% specificity were reported. The diagnostic performance of previously published cut-offs was also evaluated. Sequential combinations of serum biomarkers and LSM-VCTE were evaluated, by computing sensitivity, specificity and proportions of misclassified and indeterminate patients.
85: 
86: Positive and negative predictive values (PPV and NPV) were estimated for prevalences within the range of those reported in the original studies. The number of false positive and false negative results for 100 theoretical cases was also reported.
87: 
88: The main analysis was conducted to maximise data for each NIT. For a valid comparison of the performance of NITs, a separate analysis was conducted in the subgroup of patients where all three of VCTE, FIB-4 and NFS were available in each participant.
89: 
90: To fulfil the aim of developing testing strategies that reduce the number of patients in need of a liver biopsy, lower cut-offs for ruling out advanced fibrosis and upper cut-offs for ruling in cirrhosis were used. The rationale for this approach is illustrated in online supplemental figure 1 . The upper cut-offs for identifying cirrhosis were chosen at 95% and 98% specificity in a derivation set and tested in a validation set. Derivation and validation sets were obtained by random sampling from the IPD study group in a 3:2 ratio. These upper cut-offs were combined with lower cut-offs from the literature for ruling out advanced fibrosis and the algorithm was tested in the whole IPD study group. For ease of reference, we also examined the cut-offs of 8 kPa and 10 kPa (corresponding to the most common VCTE cut-offs in the literature of 7.9 kPa and 9.6 kPa rounded to the nearest integer) and also rounded our cirrhosis cut-offs to the nearest integer to facilitate application in clinical practice.
91: 
92: Only test-positive and test-negative patients were included in the calculation of diagnostic performance indices, and patients in the indeterminate group were excluded from calculations.
93: 
94: Subgroup analysis was performed according to biopsy length (<20 mm, ≥20 mm), number of portal tracts in biopsy samples (<11, ≥11), biopsy quality (intermediate: 10 mm ≤length <20 mm; high: length ≥20 mm and ≥11 tracts), age (four quartiles), sex, body mass index (BMI; BMI <25 kg/m 2 , 25 kg/m 2 ≤ BMI <30 kg/m 2 , BMI ≥30 kg/m 2 ), presence of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), continent of provenance (Europe, Asia), probes used (M, XL), reliability criteria for LSM-VCTE (reliable (median LSM <7.1 kPa or median LSM ≥7.1 kPa and IQR/median LSM <0.30) vs unreliable (median LSM ≥7.1 kPa and IQR/median LSM ≥0.30) 22 ; reliable (IQR/median LSM <0.30) vs unreliable (IQR/median LSM ≥0.30)), and aminotransferase levels (ALT or AST<40, 40≤ALT or AST<100, ALT or AST≥100; ALT<40 and AST<40, ALT≥40 or AST≥40.
95: 
96: All statistical analyses were performed using R (V.1.2.1335, R Foundation for Statistical Computing, Vienna, Austria) with the pROC package 24 25 ; 95% CIs were calculated using 500 stratified bootstrap replicates using the boot package. 26 27
97: 
98: #### VCTE probe types
99: 
100: The analysis to account for probe type is described in the online supplemental materials .
101: 
102: ### Patient and public involvement
103: 
104: Patients and the public were not involved in the conduct of this study as there was no direct patient participation in the study.
105: 
106: ## Results
107: 
108: ### Search process and data collection
109: 
110: Ten thousand three hundred ninety-two articles were identified in a search performed for a larger systematic review evaluating the diagnostic performance of LSM-VCTE and other index tests for the staging of fibrosis and diagnosis of NASH in adult patients with NAFLD. After removing duplicates, and screening titles, abstracts, and full texts, 59 studies examining VCTE were identified. The authors of 37 studies shared useable data ( figure 1 ). Authors of more than one study supplied data in a single dataset and, overall, we received 30 data sets including data from 6571 patients. After removing duplicates (n=628) and patients with missing biopsy (n=14) or LSM-VCTE (n=194) data, the final dataset consisted of 5735 unique patients.

IPD, individual patient data; LSM, liver stiffness measurement; VCTE, vibration controlled transient elastography.
113: 
114: ### Study and population characteristics
115: 
116: The characteristics of the 30 data sets are summarised in table 1 . Studies were conducted in Europe (67%), Asia (40%) and Australia (3%). Data availability is shown in online supplemental table 3 . FIB-4 and NFS were determined in 5393 (94%) and 3248 (57%) cases, respectively. Median age was 54 years, 2570 (45%) patients were women, 33% had diabetes and 43% had BMI ≥30 kg/m 2 . Overall, 30% had advanced fibrosis and 11% had cirrhosis. Details of the IPD study group are included in table 2 , and online supplemental tables 4 and 5 .

122: ### Study quality
123: 
124: The methodological quality of the studies assessed with the QUADAS-2 tool is summarised in online supplemental figures 2 and 3 . Only one study had low risk of bias or low applicability concerns in all QUADAS-2 domains. 28 The flow and timing domain were judged to have high risk or unclear risk of bias in 65% of studies, as these either excluded technical failures from their final diagnostic performance analysis or did not report them.
125: 
126: ### Validating the diagnostic performance of LSM by VCTE and serum-based tests for detecting advanced fibrosis
127: 
128: LSM-VCTE, FIB-4, NFS, APRI and AST/ALT had corresponding AUROCs of 0.85, 0.76, 0.73, 0.70, 0.64 for identifying advanced fibrosis ( table 3 ), and 0.90, 0.80, 0.78, 0.72, 0.69 for the identification of cirrhosis ( online supplemental table 6 ). LSM-VCTE performed significantly better (p<10 −15 ) in detecting both advanced fibrosis and cirrhosis than all serum-based tests. This relationship was preserved when performing a head-to-head comparison of LSM-VCTE, FIB-4 and NFS in the same group of patients ( online supplemental tables 7 and 8 ).

132: When considering cut-offs from the literature, we evaluated lower and higher cut-offs separately. For any given test, as would be expected, low thresholds yielded higher sensitivity and high thresholds were associated with higher specificity ( online supplemental table 9 ). Indicative PPV and NPV are also provided for the range of prevalences (5%–50%) reported in the primary studies ( online supplemental tables 10–14 ).

# NAFLD 患者晚期纤维化无创检测的诊断准确性：一项个体患者数据 Meta 分析（改写科研正文）

> 本文为对已发表论文的**结构化改写**，全部方法、样本量、数值、局限性与结论均取自已核验的开放获取原始全文，未逐字复制，未据题名/摘要推断全文事实。
>
> **事实底稿（题名、DOI、PMCID 完全匹配）**
> - 题名：Diagnostic accuracy of non-invasive tests for advanced fibrosis in patients with NAFLD: an individual patient data meta-analysis
> - 作者：Mózes FE, …, Pavlides M（LITMUS Investigators 合作组）
> - 期刊：Gut（BMJ），2021 年在线首发（原文含更正声明，见文末）
> - **DOI：10.1136/gutjnl-2021-324243**
> - **PMCID：PMC8995830** ｜ PMID：34001645
> - 全文来源（公开）：https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC8995830
> - 注册号：PROSPERO CRD42019157661

---

## 摘要

**目的**　非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）的很多患者仍须依赖肝活检进行纤维化分期。本研究旨在评价振动控制瞬时弹性成像测量的肝硬度值（LSM-VCTE）、Fibrosis-4 指数（FIB-4）与 NAFLD 纤维化评分（NFS）各自的诊断性能，并推导能够减少肝活检需求的诊断策略。

**设计**　这是一项个体患者数据 Meta 分析（IPDMA），纳入以肝组织学为参照、同时报告 LSM-VCTE 的研究；在数据可得的情况下计算 FIB-4 与 NFS。分别计算敏感度、特异度与受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC），对标志物单独及序贯组合进行评估。

**结果**　共纳入 37 项原始研究，合计 5735 例患者（45% 为女性，中位年龄 54 岁，中位体质指数 30 kg/m²，33% 合并 2 型糖尿病，30% 为晚期纤维化）。LSM-VCTE、FIB-4、NFS 对晚期纤维化的 AUROC 分别为 0.85、0.76、0.73。采用 FIB-4 双阈值（<1.3；≥2.67）继以 LSM-VCTE 双阈值（<8.0；≥10.0 kPa）来排除或纳入晚期纤维化时，敏感度与特异度（95% CI）分别为 66%（63–68）与 86%（84–87），33% 的患者仍须肝活检方能确诊。采用 FIB-4 双阈值（<1.3；≥3.48）继以 LSM 双阈值（<8.0；≥20.0 kPa）以排除晚期纤维化或纳入肝硬化时，敏感度为 38%（37–39）、特异度为 90%（89–91），仅 19% 的患者须肝活检。

**结论**　以较低阈值排除晚期纤维化、以较高阈值纳入肝硬化的序贯组合策略，可减少肝活检需求。

**关键词**　肝纤维化；脂肪肝；临床决策；生物统计学

---

## 引言

NAFLD 是代谢综合征的肝脏表现，全球患病率高。多数患者长期无症状、进展缓慢，但少数会进展为肝硬化、肝衰竭与肝细胞癌（HCC）。NAFLD 的病理谱系从单纯脂肪变延伸至脂肪性肝炎，并伴有不同程度的纤维化；其诊断参照标准仍为肝活检，但肝活检具有侵入性、有并发症风险，且受取样变异与阅片者间差异影响。

临床上的关键难题是识别进展风险高的患者，以便转诊专科随访。已有充分证据表明，至少达到晚期纤维化（F3–4）的患者远期肝相关事件风险更高。以无创检测（NIT）进行风险分层的常用做法是序贯使用两种检测：一线为简便廉价的血清学指标（如 FIB-4 或 NFS），二线为肝硬度测量（如 VCTE）或专有血清学检测（如增强肝纤维化检测 ELF）。每一层通常设较低与较高两个阈值，分别用于“排除”（低于低阈值）或“纳入”（高于高阈值）高风险患者；两层均落入中间区间的患者才需肝活检。此类策略的核心价值在于其较高的阴性预测值，可将低风险患者安全地留在初级医疗管理。

但该策略仍有若干问题待澄清：其一，阈值选择缺乏共识（如 FIB-4 高阈值有 3.25 与 2.67 等不同方案，亦有研究者索性不设高阈值）；其二，NIT 在特定亚组（如糖尿病或肥胖患者）中的表现仍不确定；其三，对被纳入为高风险的 F3–4 患者，往往仍需肝活检以识别须行 HCC 监测的肝硬化人群。因此，减少二级医疗中肝活检需求是尚未满足的临床需求。

为此，本研究开展 IPDMA，设定三项目标：(1) 评价 LSM-VCTE 的表现，并与 FIB-4、NFS 作为排除晚期纤维化筛查工具进行比较；(2) 评估 NIT 组合策略，以尽量减少二级医疗中须肝活检的例数；(3) 探索影响诊断准确性的因素。

---

## 方法

**设计与报告规范**　本研究按 PRISMA-IPD 声明报告，注册号为 PROSPERO CRD42019157661，系 LITMUS（Liver Investigation: Testing Marker Utility in Steatohepatitis）研究的一部分。

**纳入标准**
- 患者：成人（≥18 岁）NAFLD，且同时具备肝组织学与 LSM-VCTE 配对数据；对病因未加选择的原始研究，仅纳入其中 NAFLD 患者的个体数据。
- 待评价检测：主要为 FibroScan（Echosens，法国）实施的 LSM-VCTE；在数据可得时另计算 NFS、FIB-4、AST/ALT 比值与 AST/血小板比值指数（APRI）。
- 参照标准：仅纳入按 NASH CRN 分期系统进行组织学纤维化分级的研究。
- 目标状态：晚期纤维化（F3–4）与肝硬化（F4）；阈值分别用于“排除/纳入晚期纤维化”及“排除晚期纤维化/纳入肝硬化”。
- 研究设计：不限设计，但须报告 6 个月内同时接受肝活检与 LSM-VCTE；不限语言。

**数据收集与核查**　联系原始研究作者获取数据，对测量值进行范围核查并澄清疑问；缺失数据采用成对删除。LSM-VCTE 中位硬度 ≥7.1 kPa 且四分位距/中位值比 >30% 者按“不可靠”处理（Boursier 标准），纳入主分析并另作亚组比较。数据去重后合并。

**质量评价**　采用 QUADAS-2 工具。

**统计分析**　合并各研究数据集后，构建非参数经验 ROC 曲线，以 DeLong 法计算 AUROC 及 95% CI，并以 DeLong 检验比较 AUROC。报告最大化约登指数（敏感度+特异度−1）、90% 敏感度与 90% 特异度对应的阈值，并评价既往发表阈值的表现；对血清学指标与 LSM-VCTE 的序贯组合，计算敏感度、特异度及误分类/中间区间比例。PPV 与 NPV 按原始研究报道的患病率范围（5%–50%）估算，并给出每 100 例理论病例的假阳性/假阴性数。为使标志物可比，另在每例患者均具备 VCTE、FIB-4、NFS 三项数据的亚组中进行头对头比较。肝硬化高阈值在按 3:2 随机划分的推导集/验证集中以 95% 与 98% 特异度确定；推导所得高阈值与文献低阈值组合后在全队列检验。为便于临床使用，另将 VCTE 阈值四舍五入（8、10 kPa 等）。仅将“检测阳性”与“检测阴性”者纳入诊断性能计算，中间区间者被排除。亚组分析覆盖活检长度/汇管区数目/活检质量、年龄四分位、性别、BMI（<25、25–<30、≥30 kg/m²）、2 型糖尿病、来源大洲（欧洲、亚洲）、探头类型（M、XL）、LSM 可靠性标准及转氨酶水平。全部分析以 R（pROC 与 boot 包）完成，95% CI 采用 500 次分层自助法估计。

---

## 结果

**检索与数据纳入**　在一项更大范围的系统评价中共检索到 10 392 篇文献；去除重复并筛选后，59 项研究考察了 VCTE，其中 37 项研究的作者提供了可用数据，合并为 30 个数据集、共 6571 例患者。去除重复（628 例）、缺失活检（14 例）与缺失 LSM-VCTE（194 例）后，最终纳入 **5735 例**唯一患者。

**人群特征**　研究分别来自欧洲（67%）、亚洲（40%）与澳大利亚（3%）。FIB-4 与 NFS 分别在 5393 例（94%）与 3248 例（57%）中可计算。中位年龄 54 岁，2570 例（45%）为女性，33% 合并糖尿病，43% 的 BMI ≥30 kg/m²；总体 30% 为晚期纤维化、11% 为肝硬化。

**研究质量**　仅 1 项研究在 QUADAS-2 所有领域均为低偏倚、低适用性顾虑；65% 的研究在“流程与时序”领域被评为高或不确定偏倚风险，多因排除或未报告技术失败。

**单标志物诊断性能**　对晚期纤维化，LSM-VCTE、FIB-4、NFS、APRI 与 AST/ALT 的 AUROC 分别为 0.85、0.76、0.73、0.70、0.64；对肝硬化则分别为 0.90、0.80、0.78、0.72、0.69。LSM-VCTE 对两种目标状态的表现均显著优于所有血清学检测（p<10⁻¹⁵），且在相同患者亚组的头对头比较中该优势保持。因 APRI 与 AST/ALT 表现有限（AUROC ≤0.70），后续不再考虑。无论采用何种单一阈值，均未能同时达到高敏感度（≥80%）与高特异度（≥80%）。

**双阈值与序贯组合**　LSM-VCTE 文献阈值中仅两组表现较好：<7.1 kPa 与 ≥14.1 kPa（敏感度 83%、特异度 90%）、<7.9 kPa 与 ≥9.6 kPa（敏感度 84%、特异度 78%）；FIB-4 的 <1.3 与 ≥2.67、<1.3 与 ≥3.25 特异度分别达 91% 与 95%，但敏感度 <60%，且血清学指标的中间区间比例 >30%。由本研究数据推导的阈值对并未降低误分类与中间区间比例。将文献中的 FIB-4（<1.3 & ≥2.67 或 <1.3 & ≥3.25）或 NFS（<−1.455 & ≥0.676）阈值，与表现最佳的 LSM-VCTE 阈值对（<7.9 kPa & ≥9.6 kPa）序贯组合时，中间区间比例降至 5%；FIB-4+LSM-VCTE 与 NFS+LSM-VCTE 的特异度均 >80%，但敏感度 ≤80%。采用本研究推导阈值（FIB-4 <0.88 & ≥2.31；NFS <−2.55 & ≥0.28）可提高敏感度，但中间区间比例接近 20%，且须接受 LSM-VCTE 的患者比例更大。

**减少肝活检的算法**　推导集中，诊断肝硬化的 95% 与 98% 特异度阈值分别为：LSM-VCTE 20.4 与 27.6 kPa，FIB-4 3.48 与 4.63，NFS 1.01 与 1.57（验证集表现相似）。将 FIB-4（低阈值 1.3；高阈值 3.48/4.63）与 LSM-VCTE（低阈值 8.0 kPa；高阈值 20.0/28.0 kPa）组合，并与传统方案（LSM-VCTE 取 8 与 10 kPa）比较：新策略使须接受 LSM 的患者比例由 34% 升至 40%（95% 特异度阈值）与 44%（98% 特异度阈值），但使须肝活检者由 33% 降至 19% 与 24%。摘要层面，FIB-4（<1.3；≥2.67）继以 LSM（<8.0；≥10.0 kPa）的敏感度与特异度为 66%（63–68）与 86%（84–87），33% 须活检；FIB-4（<1.3；≥3.48）继以 LSM（<8.0；≥20.0 kPa）的敏感度与特异度为 38%（37–39）与 90%（89–91），19% 须活检。需注意，在 95% 特异度阈值策略下，656 例被“纳入”为肝硬化的患者中有 345 例在组织学上并未诊断肝硬化。

**亚组与敏感性分析**　NIT 在 BMI 较低、无 2 型糖尿病、活检长度 <20 mm 或汇管区 <11 个（即“活检质量较差”）者中表现更优；NFS 在最年轻四分位（<43 岁，AUROC 0.58）与女性（AUROC 0.71）中表现较差；来源大洲对各 NIT 均无显著影响。转氨酶方面，FIB-4 在 ALT 正常（<40）者中表现较差（AUROC 0.73）而 ALT 40–100 者较好（0.77）；NFS 在 AST<40 者中较好（0.76）而 AST≥100 者较差（0.65）。不可靠 LSM 比例为 12%；按 Boursier 标准判定为不可靠者，LSM-VCTE 表现显著较差（p<10⁻⁸），但仅以 IQR/中位值 <0.30 为标准时无差异。M 与 XL 探头间无显著差异。

---

## 讨论

本研究通过广泛的作者协作，收集了迄今同类中规模最大的数据集，覆盖欧洲、亚洲、澳大利亚，30% 为晚期纤维化，作者认为其结果适用于上述地区典型的二级医疗人群。与既往报道一致，LSM-VCTE 对晚期纤维化的表现良好（AUROC 0.85），FIB-4（0.76）与 NFS（0.73）为中等；单一阈值下无任何 NIT 同时具备 ≥80% 的敏感度与特异度，而对肝硬化的表现更高。LSM-VCTE 的单阈值（约登指数最大化，9.1 kPa）敏感度/特异度为 77%/78%，双阈值（<7.4 kPa & ≥12.1 kPa）为 84%/87%；Eddowes 等报告的 <7.1 & ≥14.1 kPa 表现良好（83%/90%），但中间区间比例达 39%，与原研究报道的 41% 相近。

序贯组合可提高敏感度与特异度、减少中间区间并降低活检相关成本。本研究进一步提出以肝硬化 95% 与 98% 特异度的高阈值“直接纳入肝硬化、免于活检”，使须活检比例由 33% 降至 19%。然而，95% 特异度阈值下 656 例被纳入肝硬化者中 345 例组织学上无肝硬化——作者认为这须结合两点解读：其一，肝活检本身的局限可能使部分患者被错误地判为“组织学无肝硬化”；其二，组织学无肝硬化但 NIT 值高者，其风险可能等同于组织学肝硬化患者（丙肝文献提示，活检无肝硬化但 FIB-4>3.25 者治疗后仍有显著 HCC 风险）。提高特异度可减少假阳性，但以增加活检为代价；作者强调仍需纵向数据比较 NIT 与组织学的预后价值，并评价各阈值的成本效果。

亚组分析中“活检质量较差者 NIT 表现更优”这一结果难以解释，可能与使用本地病理报告作为参照及阅片者间差异有关；作者已通过两亚组短活检比例接近而排除了谱系偏倚。NIT 在低 BMI 与无糖尿病患者中表现更优，作者认为主要受 BMI 驱动（BMI 与 2 型糖尿病存在因果关联）。年龄方面，所有 NIT 在最年轻四分位中对晚期纤维化的表现更差，但诊断肝硬化时趋势相反；FIB-4 与 NFS 的年龄依赖性可预期（年龄为其算法参数之一），但“年轻者对肝硬化诊断更优”难以解释。

**优势**　样本量大，晚期纤维化患病率 30% 贴近临床实际；不可靠 VCTE 测量比例 12% 与文献一致。

**局限性（作者自述）**　① 无美国数据、澳大利亚研究极少，因各人群 BMI 差异而未必全球适用；② 依赖各地本地组织学结果，可能引入偏倚；③ 覆盖时间跨度大，期间 VCTE 应用经历了 XL 探头引入、皮肝距（SCD）测量与自动探头选择等变化，早期研究仅用 M 探头，故 LSM-VCTE 表现存在异质性；④ 约三分之一研究来自法国（该技术发源地）；⑤ 数据证实 LSM-VCTE 优于血清学检测且不受探头类型、性别、ALT、AST 与来源大洲影响，但对 T2DM、BMI（及肝硬化检测）存在一定依赖，本研究未检验亚组特异性阈值；⑥ 因无 LSM-VCTE 失败信息，分析为按方案（per-protocol）进行。

**结论**　本研究进一步验证了以 FIB-4 与 LSM-VCTE 序贯组合排除晚期纤维化、并将可留于初级医疗管理的患者筛出；同时表明，以高阈值纳入肝硬化、配合低阈值排除晚期纤维化，可减少须接受肝活检的患者数。

## 摘要

**目的**　非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）的很多患者仍须依赖肝活检进行纤维化分期。本研究旨在评价振动控制瞬时弹性成像测量的肝硬度值（LSM-VCTE）、Fibrosis-4 指数（FIB-4）与 NAFLD 纤维化评分（NFS）各自的诊断性能，并推导能够减少肝活检需求的诊断策略。

**设计**　这是一项个体患者数据 Meta 分析（IPDMA），纳入以肝组织学为参照、同时报告 LSM-VCTE 的研究；在数据可得的情况下计算 FIB-4 与 NFS。分别计算敏感度、特异度与受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC），对标志物单独及序贯组合进行评估。

**结果**　共纳入 37 项原始研究，合计 5735 例患者（45% 为女性，中位年龄 54 岁，中位体质指数 30 kg/m²，33% 合并 2 型糖尿病，30% 为晚期纤维化）。LSM-VCTE、FIB-4、NFS 对晚期纤维化的 AUROC 分别为 0.85、0.76、0.73。采用 FIB-4 双阈值（<1.3；≥2.67）继以 LSM-VCTE 双阈值（<8.0；≥10.0 kPa）来排除或纳入晚期纤维化时，敏感度与特异度（95% CI）分别为 66%（63–68）与 86%（84–87），33% 的患者仍须肝活检方能确诊。采用 FIB-4 双阈值（<1.3；≥3.48）继以 LSM 双阈值（<8.0；≥20.0 kPa）以排除晚期纤维化或纳入肝硬化时，敏感度为 38%（37–39）、特异度为 90%（89–91），仅 19% 的患者须肝活检。

**结论**　以较低阈值排除晚期纤维化、以较高阈值纳入肝硬化的序贯组合策略，可减少肝活检需求。

**关键词**　肝纤维化；脂肪肝；临床决策；生物统计学

---

## 引言

NAFLD 是代谢综合征的肝脏表现，全球患病率高。多数患者长期无症状、进展缓慢，但少数会进展为肝硬化、肝衰竭与肝细胞癌（HCC）。NAFLD 的病理谱系从单纯脂肪变延伸至脂肪性肝炎，并伴有不同程度的纤维化；其诊断参照标准仍为肝活检，但肝活检具有侵入性、有并发症风险，且受取样变异与阅片者间差异影响。

临床上的关键难题是识别进展风险高的患者，以便转诊专科随访。已有充分证据表明，至少达到晚期纤维化（F3–4）的患者远期肝相关事件风险更高。以无创检测（NIT）进行风险分层的常用做法是序贯使用两种检测：一线为简便廉价的血清学指标（如 FIB-4 或 NFS），二线为肝硬度测量（如 VCTE）或专有血清学检测（如增强肝纤维化检测 ELF）。每一层通常设较低与较高两个阈值，分别用于“排除”（低于低阈值）或“纳入”（高于高阈值）高风险患者；两层均落入中间区间的患者才需肝活检。此类策略的核心价值在于其较高的阴性预测值，可将低风险患者安全地留在初级医疗管理。

但该策略仍有若干问题待澄清：其一，阈值选择缺乏共识（如 FIB-4 高阈值有 3.25 与 2.67 等不同方案，亦有研究者索性不设高阈值）；其二，NIT 在特定亚组（如糖尿病或肥胖患者）中的表现仍不确定；其三，对被纳入为高风险的 F3–4 患者，往往仍需肝活检以识别须行 HCC 监测的肝硬化人群。因此，减少二级医疗中肝活检需求是尚未满足的临床需求。

为此，本研究开展 IPDMA，设定三项目标：(1) 评价 LSM-VCTE 的表现，并与 FIB-4、NFS 作为排除晚期纤维化筛查工具进行比较；(2) 评估 NIT 组合策略，以尽量减少二级医疗中须肝活检的例数；(3) 探索影响诊断准确性的因素。

## 方法

**设计与报告规范**　本研究按 PRISMA-IPD 声明报告，注册号为 PROSPERO CRD42019157661，系 LITMUS（Liver Investigation: Testing Marker Utility in Steatohepatitis）研究的一部分。

**纳入标准**
- 患者：成人（≥18 岁）NAFLD，且同时具备肝组织学与 LSM-VCTE 配对数据；对病因未加选择的原始研究，仅纳入其中 NAFLD 患者的个体数据。
- 待评价检测：主要为 FibroScan（Echosens，法国）实施的 LSM-VCTE；在数据可得时另计算 NFS、FIB-4、AST/ALT 比值与 AST/血小板比值指数（APRI）。
- 参照标准：仅纳入按 NASH CRN 分期系统进行组织学纤维化分级的研究。
- 目标状态：晚期纤维化（F3–4）与肝硬化（F4）；阈值分别用于“排除/纳入晚期纤维化”及“排除晚期纤维化/纳入肝硬化”。
- 研究设计：不限设计，但须报告 6 个月内同时接受肝活检与 LSM-VCTE；不限语言。

**数据收集与核查**　联系原始研究作者获取数据，对测量值进行范围核查并澄清疑问；缺失数据采用成对删除。LSM-VCTE 中位硬度 ≥7.1 kPa 且四分位距/中位值比 >30% 者按“不可靠”处理（Boursier 标准），纳入主分析并另作亚组比较。数据去重后合并。

**质量评价**　采用 QUADAS-2 工具。

**统计分析**　合并各研究数据集后，构建非参数经验 ROC 曲线，以 DeLong 法计算 AUROC 及 95% CI，并以 DeLong 检验比较 AUROC。报告最大化约登指数（敏感度+特异度−1）、90% 敏感度与 90% 特异度对应的阈值，并评价既往发表阈值的表现；对血清学指标与 LSM-VCTE 的序贯组合，计算敏感度、特异度及误分类/中间区间比例。PPV 与 NPV 按原始研究报道的患病率范围（5%–50%）估算，并给出每 100 例理论病例的假阳性/假阴性数。为使标志物可比，另在每例患者均具备 VCTE、FIB-4、NFS 三项数据的亚组中进行头对头比较。肝硬化高阈值在按 3:2 随机划分的推导集/验证集中以 95% 与 98% 特异度确定；推导所得高阈值与文献低阈值组合后在全队列检验。为便于临床使用，另将 VCTE 阈值四舍五入（8、10 kPa 等）。仅将“检测阳性”与“检测阴性”者纳入诊断性能计算，中间区间者被排除。亚组分析覆盖活检长度/汇管区数目/活检质量、年龄四分位、性别、BMI（<25、25–<30、≥30 kg/m²）、2 型糖尿病、来源大洲（欧洲、亚洲）、探头类型（M、XL）、LSM 可靠性标准及转氨酶水平。全部分析以 R（pROC 与 boot 包）完成，95% CI 采用 500 次分层自助法估计。

## 结果

**检索与数据纳入**　在一项更大范围的系统评价中共检索到 10 392 篇文献；去除重复并筛选后，59 项研究考察了 VCTE，其中 37 项研究的作者提供了可用数据，合并为 30 个数据集、共 6571 例患者。去除重复（628 例）、缺失活检（14 例）与缺失 LSM-VCTE（194 例）后，最终纳入 **5735 例**唯一患者。

**人群特征**　研究分别来自欧洲（67%）、亚洲（40%）与澳大利亚（3%）。FIB-4 与 NFS 分别在 5393 例（94%）与 3248 例（57%）中可计算。中位年龄 54 岁，2570 例（45%）为女性，33% 合并糖尿病，43% 的 BMI ≥30 kg/m²；总体 30% 为晚期纤维化、11% 为肝硬化。

**研究质量**　仅 1 项研究在 QUADAS-2 所有领域均为低偏倚、低适用性顾虑；65% 的研究在“流程与时序”领域被评为高或不确定偏倚风险，多因排除或未报告技术失败。

**单标志物诊断性能**　对晚期纤维化，LSM-VCTE、FIB-4、NFS、APRI 与 AST/ALT 的 AUROC 分别为 0.85、0.76、0.73、0.70、0.64；对肝硬化则分别为 0.90、0.80、0.78、0.72、0.69。LSM-VCTE 对两种目标状态的表现均显著优于所有血清学检测（p<10⁻¹⁵），且在相同患者亚组的头对头比较中该优势保持。因 APRI 与 AST/ALT 表现有限（AUROC ≤0.70），后续不再考虑。无论采用何种单一阈值，均未能同时达到高敏感度（≥80%）与高特异度（≥80%）。

**双阈值与序贯组合**　LSM-VCTE 文献阈值中仅两组表现较好：<7.1 kPa 与 ≥14.1 kPa（敏感度 83%、特异度 90%）、<7.9 kPa 与 ≥9.6 kPa（敏感度 84%、特异度 78%）；FIB-4 的 <1.3 与 ≥2.67、<1.3 与 ≥3.25 特异度分别达 91% 与 95%，但敏感度 <60%，且血清学指标的中间区间比例 >30%。由本研究数据推导的阈值对并未降低误分类与中间区间比例。将文献中的 FIB-4（<1.3 & ≥2.67 或 <1.3 & ≥3.25）或 NFS（<−1.455 & ≥0.676）阈值，与表现最佳的 LSM-VCTE 阈值对（<7.9 kPa & ≥9.6 kPa）序贯组合时，中间区间比例降至 5%；FIB-4+LSM-VCTE 与 NFS+LSM-VCTE 的特异度均 >80%，但敏感度 ≤80%。采用本研究推导阈值（FIB-4 <0.88 & ≥2.31；NFS <−2.55 & ≥0.28）可提高敏感度，但中间区间比例接近 20%，且须接受 LSM-VCTE 的患者比例更大。

**减少肝活检的算法**　推导集中，诊断肝硬化的 95% 与 98% 特异度阈值分别为：LSM-VCTE 20.4 与 27.6 kPa，FIB-4 3.48 与 4.63，NFS 1.01 与 1.57（验证集表现相似）。将 FIB-4（低阈值 1.3；高阈值 3.48/4.63）与 LSM-VCTE（低阈值 8.0 kPa；高阈值 20.0/28.0 kPa）组合，并与传统方案（LSM-VCTE 取 8 与 10 kPa）比较：新策略使须接受 LSM 的患者比例由 34% 升至 40%（95% 特异度阈值）与 44%（98% 特异度阈值），但使须肝活检者由 33% 降至 19% 与 24%。摘要层面，FIB-4（<1.3；≥2.67）继以 LSM（<8.0；≥10.0 kPa）的敏感度与特异度为 66%（63–68）与 86%（84–87），33% 须活检；FIB-4（<1.3；≥3.48）继以 LSM（<8.0；≥20.0 kPa）的敏感度与特异度为 38%（37–39）与 90%（89–91），19% 须活检。需注意，在 95% 特异度阈值策略下，656 例被“纳入”为肝硬化的患者中有 345 例在组织学上并未诊断肝硬化。

**亚组与敏感性分析**　NIT 在 BMI 较低、无 2 型糖尿病、活检长度 <20 mm 或汇管区 <11 个（即“活检质量较差”）者中表现更优；NFS 在最年轻四分位（<43 岁，AUROC 0.58）与女性（AUROC 0.71）中表现较差；来源大洲对各 NIT 均无显著影响。转氨酶方面，FIB-4 在 ALT 正常（<40）者中表现较差（AUROC 0.73）而 ALT 40–100 者较好（0.77）；NFS 在 AST<40 者中较好（0.76）而 AST≥100 者较差（0.65）。不可靠 LSM 比例为 12%；按 Boursier 标准判定为不可靠者，LSM-VCTE 表现显著较差（p<10⁻⁸），但仅以 IQR/中位值 <0.30 为标准时无差异。M 与 XL 探头间无显著差异。

## 讨论

本研究通过广泛的作者协作，收集了迄今同类中规模最大的数据集，覆盖欧洲、亚洲、澳大利亚，30% 为晚期纤维化，作者认为其结果适用于上述地区典型的二级医疗人群。与既往报道一致，LSM-VCTE 对晚期纤维化的表现良好（AUROC 0.85），FIB-4（0.76）与 NFS（0.73）为中等；单一阈值下无任何 NIT 同时具备 ≥80% 的敏感度与特异度，而对肝硬化的表现更高。LSM-VCTE 的单阈值（约登指数最大化，9.1 kPa）敏感度/特异度为 77%/78%，双阈值（<7.4 kPa & ≥12.1 kPa）为 84%/87%；Eddowes 等报告的 <7.1 & ≥14.1 kPa 表现良好（83%/90%），但中间区间比例达 39%，与原研究报道的 41% 相近。

序贯组合可提高敏感度与特异度、减少中间区间并降低活检相关成本。本研究进一步提出以肝硬化 95% 与 98% 特异度的高阈值“直接纳入肝硬化、免于活检”，使须活检比例由 33% 降至 19%。然而，95% 特异度阈值下 656 例被纳入肝硬化者中 345 例组织学上无肝硬化——作者认为这须结合两点解读：其一，肝活检本身的局限可能使部分患者被错误地判为“组织学无肝硬化”；其二，组织学无肝硬化但 NIT 值高者，其风险可能等同于组织学肝硬化患者（丙肝文献提示，活检无肝硬化但 FIB-4>3.25 者治疗后仍有显著 HCC 风险）。提高特异度可减少假阳性，但以增加活检为代价；作者强调仍需纵向数据比较 NIT 与组织学的预后价值，并评价各阈值的成本效果。

亚组分析中“活检质量较差者 NIT 表现更优”这一结果难以解释，可能与使用本地病理报告作为参照及阅片者间差异有关；作者已通过两亚组短活检比例接近而排除了谱系偏倚。NIT 在低 BMI 与无糖尿病患者中表现更优，作者认为主要受 BMI 驱动（BMI 与 2 型糖尿病存在因果关联）。年龄方面，所有 NIT 在最年轻四分位中对晚期纤维化的表现更差，但诊断肝硬化时趋势相反；FIB-4 与 NFS 的年龄依赖性可预期（年龄为其算法参数之一），但“年轻者对肝硬化诊断更优”难以解释。

**优势**　样本量大，晚期纤维化患病率 30% 贴近临床实际；不可靠 VCTE 测量比例 12% 与文献一致。

**局限性（作者自述）**　① 无美国数据、澳大利亚研究极少，因各人群 BMI 差异而未必全球适用；② 依赖各地本地组织学结果，可能引入偏倚；③ 覆盖时间跨度大，期间 VCTE 应用经历了 XL 探头引入、皮肝距（SCD）测量与自动探头选择等变化，早期研究仅用 M 探头，故 LSM-VCTE 表现存在异质性；④ 约三分之一研究来自法国（该技术发源地）；⑤ 数据证实 LSM-VCTE 优于血清学检测且不受探头类型、性别、ALT、AST 与来源大洲影响，但对 T2DM、BMI（及肝硬化检测）存在一定依赖，本研究未检验亚组特异性阈值；⑥ 因无 LSM-VCTE 失败信息，分析为按方案（per-protocol）进行。

**结论**　本研究进一步验证了以 FIB-4 与 LSM-VCTE 序贯组合排除晚期纤维化、并将可留于初级医疗管理的患者筛出；同时表明，以高阈值纳入肝硬化、配合低阈值排除晚期纤维化，可减少须接受肝活检的患者数。
